title: Build: multi-year ETF/equity 1h+5m history pipeline (Alpaca/IB/open sources) into the trainer canonical store, with freshness check + daily refresh
note: Operator 2026-11-01: 'no way we are limited to 2 years of etf data'. Yahoo 1h caps ~730d; pipeline gap, not a data limit. Lane ETF-HISTORY-PIPELINE (Manager Session 2026-11-01a), ceiling 30 USD, due_by 2026-11-01. Supersedes the data-gap half of TF-EQUITY-INTRADAY-BARS. Scope: measured source inventory, runner/trainer pipeline, freshness check + daily incremental, depth read-back, notify ML-FEATURE-INFRA / ALPACA-LIVE-ACTIVITY-ML / RESEARCH-EDGE. [2026-11-01 lane] BUILT, NOT RUN: PR #22136 (held, Tier-2 workflow). No keys in a lane sandbox so NO depth table exists yet. CLOSES WHEN: after merge, label etf-history-request body 'mode: probe' (measures Alpaca SIP/IEX depth per timeframe + Yahoo/Stooq keyless), then 'mode: backfill', then 'mode: verify' shows >=8y 1h and per-symbol 5m first/last/rows/gaps for the ~31-symbol universe; the 3 ML/research lanes are then told the read path (trainer data/etf_history/<SYM>/<tf>.parquet via fetch_etf_history.read_bars). NOT DONE: IB historical path (documented, unmeasured; needs gateway via live VM) -- cross-check source only, MES/MGC/MHG futures are not Alpaca-covered. [2026-11-01 lane, later] WIDENED to config/data_universe.yaml (1,019 equity symbols = 274 ETFs + 503 current + 242 removed S&P 500 names; 55 option underlyings); store is per-year parquet; quarterly sp500-membership-refresh.yml; publish-to-HF-lake step inert until repo variable MARKET_LAKE_HF_REPO is set (coordinating with lane MARKET-DATA-LAKE). Trainer disk is a CACHE; disk preflight stays as the cache guard. [2026-11-01 lane, 1m base] Operator rule (relayed by MARKET-DATA-LAKE): keep the smallest timeframe. Store is now the 1m BASE in monthly partitions; 5m/1h derived on read (resample_bars). MEASURED trainer disk (diag #22140): 97 GB, 53 used, 45 GB free, pandas 3.0.3, pyarrow 24.0.0, 1 CPU, 5.9 GB RAM. 1m projection ~14 GB (10-25) for ~770 symbols with data, ~55k Alpaca requests (~6 h at 150/min = ~3-4 resumable runs): PROJECTION, not measured on real data. Workflow stops <15 GB to start / <10 GB mid-run with numbers. Derived-vs-native cross-check filed (due 11-04). [2026-11-01 lane, store of record] Per manager/operator design mandate the HF lake (bentzbk/jta-market-lake) is the STORE OF RECORD for the 1m base; trainer is a TAIL CACHE (current+previous month). Workflow hands each finished chunk to MARKET-DATA-LAKE's publisher (free_sources.py import-etf + hf_publish.py upload), guarded: if scripts/data_lake or HF_TOKEN is absent, or a publish fails, that chunk goes to the trainer IN FULL so no history is dropped. Trainer pruning of old months deliberately NOT automated until the lake copy is confirmed. [2026-11-01 15:40Z PAUSED for usage hold, re-dated to 2026-11-05] STOPPED AT: PR #22136 head e5d46d4d1 (after merging origin/main: it had been 'dirty', so GitHub never created guards/pytest-collect/pytest-run; they now exist and were QUEUED at 15:20Z, none reported). Locally green on that tree: 69 tests, soak-contract, roadmap-map, document-index, impossibility-claim, diagnostic-provenance, research-workflow-landing, workflow guards, ruff E731; py3.11 compile ok. This pause-note commit restarts CI once. DONE: 1m-base store (monthly partitions, 5m/1h derived on read), chunked fetch with lake hand-off (guarded) + trainer tail cache, disk floors (start>=15 GB, stop<10 GB; MEASURED trainer 97/53/45 GB free), options snapshot workflow, quarterly S&P refresh, schedule_keeper + health.json, ONE shared data_universe.yaml. NOT DONE / NEXT: (1) read CI on this head; (2) after the manager merges: etf-history-request mode probe -> backfill (repeat until run.remaining 0) -> verify, options-snapshot-request mode probe -> capture, then post the depth table and tell ML-FEATURE-INFRA / ALPACA-LIVE-ACTIVITY-ML / RESEARCH-EDGE the read path (NOT yet told: no data exists); (3) PIPELINE rows PI-20261101-ETFHIST-0001..0004 (IB futures + option-IV depth, derived-vs-native cross-check, trainer prune after lake confirms). NOTHING has run against real Alpaca data: all sizes (~14 GB, range 10-25) and request counts (~55k) are projections. 2026-11-03 OPERATOR DECISION (popup, verbatim): "Keep it on the trainer (Rec.)". The trainer is the ETF 1m history store of record; no HF PRO upgrade; nothing pruned from the lake. Why: HF free-plan private storage limit reached (403 'Private storage limit reached for user bentzbk', run 41552388391 chunks 3-4). ETF_LAKE_PUBLISH=0 in etf-history-pipeline.yml is the one switch to re-enable. Trainer disk: 3,688 MB for ~120 symbols (~31 MB/symbol), free 41 GB after run 41552388391; the 681 symbols still pending add ~20 GB, so ~20 GB expected left at completion; floors unchanged (15 GB to start, 10 GB mid-run stop). Measured 2026-11-03: backfill 239 symbols/2h55m (~82/h) limited by Alpaca plan 200 req/min; SPLG/1m STALE is PI-20261102-PTDVAI3R-0004. The 120 symbols from run 41552388391 chunks 3-4 stay trainer-only. [Manager 2026-11-05a, 10:22Z] ROOT CAUSE of the red daily runs (MEASURED, run 42002783685 job 127161932392): fetch=success (59 fetched, 960 skipped_fresh, 0 failed), verify=failure ONLY because 4 of 1019 1m series read STALE: SPLG, KVUE, PSKY, WBD. Each is plausibly a renamed or delisted ticker (SPLG -> SPYM; the others had corporate events), so verify counts a series that stopped trading as STALE instead of 'ended'. Scheduled runs: 6 failures + 2 cancelled, 11-03 07:12Z .. 11-05 09:29Z. FIX (Tier 1): classify a series as ended when corporate_actions (32,050 rows already fetched) records a symbol change or delisting, and map SPLG->SPYM. This subsumes PI-20261102-PTDVAI3R-0004. Done when the next scheduled run reads verify=success with red=0. [Manager 2026-11-05a] The blocked_on edge was stale: PR #22136 is CLOSED unmerged. Re-queued at rank 2 for the verify fix above.
